Claude Code can pull components through the shadcn MCP, and the new Field, Empty and Questionnaire components cover form UX and empty states. This is a 2025-2026 change that makes it much better than commonly believed.
gems.use_in_pool: Create a private '@pool' registry (pool card, bid row, price chip, status timeline) so all 5 developers install identical components. Use Questionnaire for seller onboarding and KYC steps, Empty for 'no pools near you yet', and tweakcn to generate the brand theme in minutes. shadcn charts cover the seller and admin dashboards.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds a shared design-system distribution. Replaces ad-hoc copy-paste and bespoke form wizards.
gems.license_or_pricing: shadcn MIT, free; tweakcn Apache-2.0, free
gems.activity_evidence: shadcn/ui 124,872 stars, shadcn@4.21.0 released 2026-09-04; tweakcn 10,417 stars, last push 2026-09-03.
gems.maturity_risk: Low for shadcn. tweakcn is a single-maintainer project, but you only export CSS variables from it, so lock-in is zero.

gems.name: Reanimated 4 (CSS animations and transitions syntax)
gems.what_it_is: Reanimated 4 lets you write CSS-style keyframe animations and transitions (animationName, transitionProperty) directly in React Native styles, running on Android, iOS and Web.
gems.why_gem: It is well known, but many developers still write heavy worklet code. The 4.x CSS API makes 80% of micro-interactions declarative and cheap, which suits 5 TypeScript web developers. Bluesky's production app is on Reanimated ~4.6. Latest is 4.7.0.
gems.use_in_pool: Every micro-interaction: the pool progress bar filling, the price chip pulsing when a new lower bid lands, status-timeline steps ticking, and a skeleton shimmer. Also the React Native side of the animated price ticker, since there is no maintained RN port of NumberFlow.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces the RN Animated API, Moti and hand-written worklets for simple cases.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free
gems.maturity_risk: Low. The 4.x line requires the New Architecture.

gems.name: Pulsar (react-native-pulsar) haptics SDK by Software Mansion
gems.what_it_is: A cross-platform haptics SDK with 150+ presets, a pattern composer and a realtime composer that is worklet-compatible with Reanimated. It detects each device's haptic capability and falls back automatically. Pulsar Studio designs custom haptics, including from Lottie or audio.
gems.why_gem: It was created in October 2025 and is barely known (458 stars), yet it already has about 104k weekly downloads. The alternative, expo-haptics, offers only a handful of basic impacts. Pulsar's capability fallback matters for cheap Android phones with poor vibration motors.
gems.use_in_pool: Tactile confirmation at trust moments: a 'coin drop' when the Wave Drop refund lands, a firm tick when the delivery code is verified, and a light tap when a new bid arrives. It makes the demo feel premium without extra UI.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces expo-haptics and react-native-haptic-feedback.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT (SDK). Pulsar Studio pricing not verified.
gems.activity_evidence: 458 stars; react-native-pulsar 1.7.0 (npm modified 2026-08-11); repo pushed 2026-09-21; about 104k weekly downloads.
gems.maturity_risk: Young. Requires the New Architecture and RN 0.71+. Advanced effects need Android API 30+ (envelopes API 36+).

gems.name: NumberFlow (@number-flow/react)
gems.what_it_is: A dependency-free, accessible animated-number component. Digits roll smoothly when the value changes. It takes Intl.NumberFormat options and locales and respects reduced motion by default.
gems.why_gem: For the single most important POOL moment, the price dropping as the pool grows, it gives Robinhood-style digit rolling in one component. It is correct with Intl formatting, so '₹1,24,999' in en-IN grouping and '$1,249.99' both work. About 2.1M weekly downloads, yet rarely mentioned in 'best libraries' lists.
gems.use_in_pool: The web and PWA pool page: live per-buyer price, the 'you save' amount and the member count. On React Native, replicate it with Reanimated, because the only RN port (rn-number-flow 0.1.6) has not been updated since 2024-11.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces hand-rolled counters and react-countup.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free
gems.activity_evidence: 7,718 stars; number-flow@0.6.2 released 2026-07-18; about 2.1M weekly npm downloads.
gems.maturity_risk: Web only (React, Vue, Svelte); there is no maintained React Native version. Still on 0.x.

gems.name: react-native-fast-confetti (Skia Atlas)
gems.what_it_is: A confetti and particle library rendered with @shopify/react-native-skia's Atlas API (batched drawing), animated with Reanimated. It offers Confetti, ContinuousConfetti, PIConfetti (burst) and CannonConfetti, supports custom SVG or image flakes, and respects reduce-motion.
gems.why_gem: Because particles are drawn in one Skia batch instead of hundreds of Views, it is the only realistic way to do celebration effects on low-end Android without jank. Its 'fastest' claim is not benchmarked, but the architecture is sound.
gems.use_in_pool: A small, tasteful burst when a pool closes successfully or a Wave Drop refund is confirmed. You can use rupee- or coin-shaped flakes. Show it once, never in a loop.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces react-native-confetti-cannon (View-based) and Lottie confetti files.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free
gems.activity_evidence: 575 stars; v2.0.2 released 2026-07-17; last push 2026-08-26.
gems.maturity_risk: Small single-maintainer project. v2 needs RN 0.79+, React 19 and Skia 2. The effect is non-critical, so the risk is acceptable.

gems.name: json-render (Vercel Labs), guardrailed generative UI
gems.what_it_is: A framework in which an LLM outputs JSON that can only use components and actions from a catalog you define (props validated with Zod), and the result renders progressively while streaming. It has a React Native package (@json-render/react-native, 25+ standard components).
gems.why_gem: It was created in January 2026 and has 18.4k stars, but is still unknown outside AI-frontend circles. It directly enforces POOL's rule that 'AI helps, never invents': the model cannot produce a component, field or action you did not whitelist. So an AI answer can never show a fake price or a fake seller badge.
gems.use_in_pool: Product identification results after a buyer pastes a link. The AI can only fill a 'ProductMatchCard', 'SpecTable' and 'ConfidenceNote' with Zod-typed fields, plus an 'Ask buyer to confirm' action. The same catalog renders on web and React Native.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds a safe generative-UI layer. It replaces free-form markdown or chat output for AI answers.
gems.license_or_pricing: Apache-2.0, free
gems.activity_evidence: 18,429 stars; created 2026-01-14; @json-render/core and react-native 0.21.0 published 2026-09-18; last push 2026-09-25.
gems.maturity_risk: Pre-1.0 (0.21) from Vercel Labs, which is experimental and not a product, so expect breaking changes. Pin the version.

gems.name: Google Stitch plus stitch-skills (MCP design-to-code for Claude Code)
gems.what_it_is: A Google Labs AI design canvas: prompts or screenshots become multi-screen UI. The official stitch-skills repo (Apache-2.0) adds agent skills for Claude Code and Cursor, including react-components, react-native, shadcn-ui and design-md, that pull designs through the Stitch MCP server into code.
gems.why_gem: Most founders compare v0 and Lovable. Stitch plus MCP is less known, and it is the one route where the design tool feeds Claude Code directly in the team's existing workflow, with a dedicated React Native conversion skill. The skills repo has 8.4k stars since January 2026.
gems.use_in_pool: Explore 5-10 visual directions for the core buyer flow (paste link, match, pool, bids, pay, code) in hours. Export a DESIGN.md with tokens, then have Claude Code turn it into Uniwind and Reusables components. Treat the output as a starting scaffold, not shipped code.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds a fast design-exploration step. Partly replaces Figma-first design and v0.
gems.license_or_pricing: stitch-skills Apache-2.0. Stitch itself was reported as free (Google Labs); exact limits not verified.
gems.activity_evidence: stitch-skills 8,400 stars, created 2026-01-16, last push 2026-08-17. Review sites report a March 2026 canvas update.
gems.maturity_risk: A Google Labs experiment, so it could change or be shut down. The exported code needs cleanup. India availability and quotas are not verified.

gems.name: mapcn (web) plus MapLibre React Native v11 on OpenFreeMap tiles
gems.what_it_is: mapcn provides shadcn-style React map components on MapLibre GL: markers, popups, routes and controls, installed through the shadcn CLI. MapLibre RN v11 is the maintained open-source native map SDK. OpenFreeMap serves free vector tiles with no API key, no request limits and commercial use allowed.
gems.why_gem: mapcn launched in December 2025 and already has 12.2k stars. Together these give Swiggy-style map UI with zero per-load map bills and no Google Maps key, and styles you fully control (on-brand, uncluttered). Watch out: mapcn's default CARTO basemap needs an enterprise licence for commercial use, so point it at OpenFreeMap or self-hosted tiles.
gems.use_in_pool: 'Pools near you' map, the seller pickup-point pin, and the delivery-proof location on the tracking timeline, on both web and the RN app.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces Google Maps SDK and Mapbox on the display side. Geocoding and routing still need a separate provider.
gems.license_or_pricing: mapcn MIT; MapLibre RN MIT; OpenFreeMap free, donation-funded (repo licence shown as NOASSERTION on GitHub).
gems.activity_evidence: mapcn 12,227 stars (created 2025-12-28, pushed 2026-09-06). MapLibre RN 666 stars, v11.4.0 released 2026-09-19. OpenFreeMap 6,106 stars, pushed 2026-09-13.
gems.maturity_risk: The OpenFreeMap public instance runs on donations with no SLA; self-host or keep a paid fallback (MapTiler or Stadia) for production. MapLibre RN has a small maintainer team.

gems.name: Lingui v6 (compile-time i18n)
gems.what_it_is: An ICU MessageFormat i18n library with compile-time macros: you write <Trans>Join pool</Trans> in code and the extractor builds PO catalogs. Plurals use Intl.PluralRules. v6.0 shipped 2026-04-22 (ESM-only, fewer dependencies, typed message IDs in 6.2); latest is 6.8.0.
gems.why_gem: Most teams default to i18next. Bluesky, a top consumer app on Expo 57 and RN 0.86, uses Lingui for its React Native app. Messages stay readable in source, translators work in standard PO files, and bundles stay small, which matters on low-end Android.
gems.use_in_pool: Telugu, Hindi and English UI strings with correct plurals ('1 buyer joined' vs '5 buyers joined'), one source of truth for web and app, and PO files a Telugu or Hindi translator can edit without code.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces i18next and react-intl.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free
gems.activity_evidence: 5,901 stars; v6.8.0 released 2026-09-23; last push 2026-09-29. Used in bluesky-social/social-app (Lingui ^5.9).
gems.maturity_risk: v6 is ESM-only, so check the Metro and Next config. The macros need a Babel or SWC plugin.

gems.name: react-native-keyboard-controller
gems.what_it_is: Keyboard handling for React Native that works the same on Android and iOS: frame-by-frame keyboard animations, KeyboardAwareScrollView, a KeyboardToolbar with next/previous field buttons, and interactive dismiss.
gems.why_gem: It is the unglamorous difference between 'feels cheap' and 'feels premium' in forms on Android, where the built-in KeyboardAvoidingView is famously broken. Bluesky ships it, and it has about 2.8M weekly downloads, yet it rarely appears in 'UI library' lists.
gems.use_in_pool: Every form: link paste, address entry, seller bid entry, and OTP or delivery-code entry. Inputs never hide behind the keyboard on cheap Android phones, and a next/done toolbar speeds up entry.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces KeyboardAvoidingView and react-native-keyboard-aware-scroll-view.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free
gems.activity_evidence: 3,737 stars; 1.22.6 released 2026-09-29; about 2.8M weekly npm downloads.
gems.maturity_risk: Low. Needs a development build (native module).

gems.name: Anek Telugu, Devanagari and Latin plus Noto Sans Telugu variable fonts (via Fontsource or expo-font)
gems.what_it_is: Anek is a variable multi-script family by Ek Type (Mumbai) covering 9 Indian scripts plus Latin, designed to match across scripts. Anek Telugu has a weight axis of 100-800 and a width axis of 75-125. Noto Sans Telugu variable has weight 100-900 and width 62.5-100. Both are OFL-1.1 and packaged on npm by Fontsource (5.3.0).
gems.why_gem: Most apps render Telugu in whatever system fallback font the phone has, so English and Telugu text look mismatched. Anek gives one visually consistent voice across Telugu, Hindi and English. The width axis lets long Telugu words fit narrow buttons without truncation.
gems.use_in_pool: Use Anek for headings, prices and buttons, where it looks best at large sizes and short text, and Noto Sans Telugu or Devanagari for body text. Web loads per-script subsets through unicode-range. The app bundles only the needed weights through expo-font.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces system-fallback Indic rendering and mismatched Latin/Indic font pairs.
gems.license_or_pricing: OFL-1.1, free
gems.activity_evidence: Google Fonts versions updated 2025-09-08 (Fontsource metadata); @fontsource-variable/anek-telugu and noto-sans-telugu 5.3.0 published 2026-07-19. The EkType repo has 76 stars (fonts are stable, last push 2022).
gems.maturity_risk: Anek is designed mainly for display sizes, so do not use it for long body text. Bundling several variable Indic fonts adds APK size; measure it.

gems.name: WhatsApp Flows (native multi-screen forms inside WhatsApp)
gems.what_it_is: Meta's framework for structured multi-screen UI rendered natively inside a WhatsApp chat: text inputs, dropdowns, date pickers, chips, PhotoPicker and an image carousel (Flow JSON 7.1). Flow JSON 7.3 and Data API 4.0 are current, and Flows work on WhatsApp Web since December 2025.
gems.why_gem: For a WhatsApp-first India product, this is a UI surface most web teams ignore. A buyer can join a pool, pick a closing time or pickup slot, or confirm an address without leaving WhatsApp or loading a web page on a slow phone.
gems.use_in_pool: 'Join this pool' Flow (quantity, pickup slot, language), 'Pool closed, accept or walk away' Flow, and seller 'submit bid' Flow for meat shops and dealers who will not install an app. Payment still goes through the PA link; the Flow does not handle money.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds a chat-native UI channel. Replaces 'tap this link to open the web app' for simple steps.
gems.license_or_pricing: Free to build. Messages follow WhatsApp Business Platform per-message pricing through the founder's BSP or Cloud API account.
gems.activity_evidence: Official changelog entries in June, July, September and November 2025. No 2026 entries were visible on the changelog page today.
gems.maturity_risk: It needs an approved WhatsApp Business account, which the founder must create. The component set is limited, the endpoint needs encryption (Data API 4.0 signatures), and UI control is less than on the web.

gems.name: TrueSheet (react-native-true-sheet v3)
gems.what_it_is: Truly native bottom sheets: Android BottomSheetBehavior and iOS UISheetPresentationController. Features include detents, footer, automatic keyboard handling, tablet side sheets, first-class Reanimated support and web support. Requires the New Architecture.
gems.why_gem: Everyone defaults to @gorhom/bottom-sheet, which is JavaScript-driven and whose last release was May 2026. TrueSheet uses the OS's own sheet, so it behaves exactly as users expect and costs less on low-end Android. It is updated almost weekly (v3.11.16, 2026-09-27).
gems.use_in_pool: The core decision sheets: bid details, 'accept this price or walk away', the payment summary before handing off to the PA checkout, and the delivery-code reveal.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces @gorhom/bottom-sheet.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free
gems.maturity_risk: Single main maintainer. v3 needs RN 0.81+ with Fabric, and v4 is in beta with RN 0.82+. @expo/ui BottomSheet is an alternative if TrueSheet stalls.

gems.name: React Bits (animated React components)
gems.what_it_is: A large collection of animated text, background and interaction components for React on the web: split text, count-up, magnet buttons, animated lists and more. Available in TypeScript and Tailwind variants.
gems.why_gem: It was the #1 rising React project of 2025 (+32.8k stars) and now has 48k stars, but it is still seen as 'portfolio candy'. Used sparingly, it gives the investor landing page and the demo web app a crafted feel in hours.
gems.use_in_pool: Investor and marketing landing page only: hero text reveal, animated savings counter, 'how a pool works' scroll story. Keep it out of the core buyer flow for performance and simplicity.
gems.replaces_or_adds: An alternative to Magic UI and Aceternity for landing-page motion.

gems.name: Rive new React Native runtime (@rive-app/react-native, Nitro-based)
gems.what_it_is: Rive's rewritten React Native runtime (0.x, Nitro modules) for interactive state-machine animations with data binding. The .riv files are small and their animation states can be driven by app data.

gems.name: Expo SDK 57 (SDK 58 beta), used as one universal codebase for Android, iOS and web
gems.what_it_is: React Native framework. In 2025-2026 the New Architecture became mandatory (from SDK 55), Hermes v1 became opt-in, and SDK 58 beta (2026-09-15) ships RN 0.88 RC, async routes on web by default, about 2x faster Android builds, expo-widgets and @expo/agent-cli.
gems.why_gem: This is the obvious choice, and it is included because it is much stronger than its 2023 reputation. Expo Router now emits a real web or PWA build from the same TypeScript screens. The whole team can build Android on Windows machines, and iOS is built in the cloud through EAS. SDK 58 cut Android build time from about 80s to about 39s (Expo changelog). A 5-person TS team gets one codebase for the Android Play app, the US iPhone app and the WhatsApp-linked web PWA.
gems.use_in_pool: One codebase covering the buyer app (paste link, join or start pool, pay, delivery code), the seller bid console and the web PWA that WhatsApp links open into.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces separate PWA plus native codebases, and Flutter (which is not TypeScript).
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT (expo 57.0.26 on npm). EAS Build and Update have a free tier; paid tiers are usage-based.
gems.maturity_risk: Low for SDK 57. SDK 58 is still beta, so pin to 57 for the pitches. Hermes v1 is not confirmed as the default, so test it on a 2-3GB RAM Android before enabling it.

gems.name: hot-updater (self-hosted OTA, CodePush replacement)
gems.what_it_is: Self-hostable OTA updates for React Native and Expo, with plugins for Supabase, Cloudflare R2/D1, AWS S3 and Firebase. It includes a web console, rollback, and bsdiff binary patches for smaller downloads.
gems.why_gem: Microsoft CodePush is retired. hot-updater is little known outside Korea and Japan, yet it ships releases every week. Its bsdiff delta patches matter for Indian users on prepaid data with low-end phones, because they download a diff instead of a full JS bundle. Storage stays in your own bucket, so there are no per-MAU EAS Update costs.
gems.use_in_pool: Push fixes to the pitch demo build during investor weeks without Play or App Store review, and ship small delta updates to buyers' phones.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces EAS Update (paid per MAU at scale) and the retired CodePush.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT (LICENSE file; GitHub shows NOASSERTION only because of formatting). Free; you pay only your storage and CDN.
gems.maturity_risk: Medium: 1.0 is still at release candidate and the project depends on a small maintainer team. Keep EAS Update as the fallback.

gems.name: xprem (formerly expo-open-ota)
gems.what_it_is: Self-hosted server for the official Expo Updates protocol. It adds a multi-app dashboard, progressive rollouts, instant rollbacks, and per-update crash and metric data through expo-observe.
gems.why_gem: It speaks the stock expo-updates protocol, so there is no custom native SDK. You keep Expo's own client and swap the server. That is a lower-lock-in alternative to hot-updater if the team wants to stay 100% on Expo primitives.
gems.use_in_pool: The same OTA role as hot-updater. Choose one of the two after a 1-day spike.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces the EAS Update hosted service.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT for everything outside the ee/ directories, which fall under the Mercure Enterprise licence. Self-hosted on your own bucket and CDN.
gems.activity_evidence: 646 stars. v3.2.5 released 2026-09-26. Created 2025-01.
gems.maturity_risk: Medium: the open-core split (ee/) could move features behind a paywall.

gems.name: Zero by Rocicorp (@rocicorp/zero)
gems.what_it_is: Query-driven sync engine. A Postgres server syncs the data each screen needs into a local client store, giving instant UI and optimistic writes. React Native is officially supported through expo-sqlite (IndexedDB on web) or op-sqlite.
gems.why_gem: In 2024 Zero was alpha. It is now at 1.9.0 on npm with 1.11 canaries, and it has first-party Expo support. Live pool counts, bid updates and buyer-joined events show up instantly without a hand-built websocket layer, and the same code works in the web PWA.
gems.use_in_pool: Live pool state: member count, countdown to the buyer-chosen close, bids arriving and Wave Drop price. It stays usable on flaky 4G and reconciles when back online.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces a hand-rolled REST, polling and websocket setup, and Firebase/Firestore.
gems.license_or_pricing: Apache-2.0. Self-host free on your own Postgres.
gems.activity_evidence: rocicorp/mono has 3,397 stars and was pushed 2026-09-30. npm @rocicorp/zero 1.9.0 modified 2026-09-30.
gems.maturity_risk: Medium. Money state such as payments and escrow must stay server-authoritative in Postgres, never client-optimistic. op-sqlite needs a dev build, not Expo Go.

gems.name: PowerSync
gems.what_it_is: Postgres/MongoDB/MySQL to SQLite sync for React Native and web, with Sync Streams for partial sync.
gems.why_gem: It is the more battle-tested alternative to Zero for true offline use, such as a seller at a meat shop with no signal who still has to verify a pickup code. It now has a self-hostable Open Edition.
gems.use_in_pool: Offline-capable seller app: today's orders, delivery or pickup codes to verify, bid drafts. It syncs when back online.
gems.replaces_or_adds: The same role as Zero; pick one.
gems.license_or_pricing: SDKs are Apache-2.0. Cloud Free covers 2GB synced/month and 50 peak clients, but free projects are deactivated after 1 week of inactivity. Pro starts at $49/month. The self-hosted Open Edition is free and source-available.
gems.activity_evidence: powersync-js has 726 stars. @powersync/web 2.4.1 released 2026-09-23. @powersync/react-native 2.3.0.
gems.maturity_risk: Low-medium. Do not leave the pitch demo on a free project that auto-deactivates.

gems.name: react-native-vision-camera v5 (Nitro-based)
gems.what_it_is: Camera library for React Native, rebuilt in v5 on Nitro Modules. It includes a barcode scanner (it can also scan static images), GPU resizing and multi-camera support.
gems.why_gem: v5 is a 2026 rewrite and is faster than the v4 most people know. It can scan barcodes from a gallery image as well as the live camera, which suits a buyer who screenshots a product box.
gems.use_in_pool: Scan an EAN or UPC on a product box to identify the exact product and match it to a pool. Scan the delivery or pickup QR code at handover.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces expo-camera barcode scanning and older ML Kit wrappers.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free.
gems.activity_evidence: 9,642 stars. v5.2.3 released 2026-08-20. Releases from April to August 2026.
gems.maturity_risk: Low-medium. It is a v5 major and needs a dev build; test on low-end Android cameras.

gems.name: barcode-detector (ZXing-C++ WASM polyfill)
gems.what_it_is: Ponyfill/polyfill of the W3C Barcode Detection API built on zxing-wasm. It supports EAN-13/8, UPC-A/E, QR, Code128, DataMatrix, PDF417 and more.
gems.why_gem: Safari/iOS does not ship the native BarcodeDetector. With this library the PWA uses one standard API everywhere, and the heavy WASM is pulled in only where it is needed. It is maintained by the zxing-wasm author and is barely known.
gems.use_in_pool: Product-box and delivery-code scanning inside the web PWA, used by iPhone users and by Android users who never install the app.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces html5-qrcode and quagga, which are older and unmaintained or weaker.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free.
gems.activity_evidence: 238 stars. v3.2.2 released 2026-08-16. Pushed 2026-09-29. zxing-wasm 3.1.4 on npm.
gems.maturity_risk: Low. A single maintainer, but it wraps mature ZXing-C++.

gems.name: expo-share-intent
gems.what_it_is: Expo native module that receives shared URLs, text, images and files on both iOS (share extension) and Android (intent filter) through a single JS handler.
gems.why_gem: POOL's core action is 'share or paste any product link'. The web Share Target API works only for installed PWAs on Android; iOS has no web share target. This module gives iPhone users 'Share > POOL' from the Amazon, Flipkart or Instagram apps with the same code as Android.
gems.use_in_pool: The Share-to-POOL entry point. A link from any shopping app opens POOL's product-identification screen.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds iOS share-extension capability that a PWA cannot provide.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free.
gems.activity_evidence: 607 stars. Pushed 2026-07-10. Version table covers SDK 54-57 (v8.0+ for SDK 57).
gems.maturity_risk: Low-medium. It depends on a single maintainer keeping pace with each Expo SDK.

gems.name: Legend List v3
gems.what_it_is: Pure-TypeScript, high-performance list component for React Native. It is a drop-in replacement for FlatList and FlashList, with dynamic item heights, recycling, bidirectional infinite scroll and chat-style alignment without inverted lists.
gems.why_gem: It has no native module, so it also works on web. It handles variable-height cards such as product offers and bids, which is where FlatList stutters on low-end Android. Chat-style 'maintainScrollAtEnd' fits a pool activity feed.
gems.use_in_pool: Pool list, offers and bids feed, and the order-tracking timeline, kept smooth on 2-3GB RAM Android.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces FlatList and FlashList.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free.
gems.activity_evidence: 3,415 stars. v3.6.0 released 2026-09-29, with several releases in September 2026.
gems.maturity_risk: Low-medium. It releases very fast, so pin the version.

gems.name: Serwist
gems.what_it_is: Maintained successor to next-pwa and a Workbox-based toolkit for service workers: precache, runtime caching, offline fallback, and Next.js, Vite and webpack plugins.
gems.why_gem: Workbox is in slow maintenance mode and next-pwa is abandoned. Serwist is the actively maintained path for offline-capable installs. Note that if the PWA is emitted by Expo Router, a hand-written service worker via Serwist's core may be needed.
gems.use_in_pool: Offline shell for the PWA, so a pool page opened from a WhatsApp link loads instantly on 2G/3G, plus cached product images and background retry of 'join pool'.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces next-pwa and raw Workbox.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT, free.
gems.activity_evidence: 1,488 stars. serwist 9.5.12 released 2026-07-22.
gems.maturity_risk: Low-medium. Integration with Expo web output needs a spike.

gems.name: Declarative Web Push (Safari/iOS 18.4+) plus iOS 26 'every Home Screen site opens as web app'
gems.what_it_is: Declarative Web Push is a WebKit feature, shipped in iOS 18.4 (March 2025), that shows push notifications from a JSON payload without needing a service worker to run. In iOS 26, every site added to the Home Screen opens as a web app by default.
gems.why_gem: Most people still think iOS PWAs cannot do reliable push. With iOS 26 plus Declarative Web Push, US iPhone buyers can get 'your pool closes in 1 hour' and 'seller bid accepted' alerts from a PWA with no App Store app, and delivery is more reliable than service-worker push.
gems.use_in_pool: US PWA notifications for pool close, Wave Drop refunds and delivery-code prompts, used before or instead of shipping the native iOS app.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds reliable iOS web push. It removes the need for a native iOS app just to get notifications.
gems.license_or_pricing: Web standard, free (APNs is used under the hood).
gems.activity_evidence: WebKit announcement; shipped in iOS 18.4. The iOS 26 Home Screen behaviour was reported by heise and on mjtsai.com (Oct 2025).
gems.maturity_risk: Medium. Safari only; Chrome and Android still use classic push, so keep a dual code path. Users must still add POOL to the Home Screen.

gems.name: Bubblewrap (Trusted Web Activity CLI)
gems.what_it_is: Google's CLI that wraps a PWA into an Android Trusted Web Activity APK/AAB for the Play Store.
gems.why_gem: It gives a Play Store listing and install for the web PWA at a few hundred KB, with no React Native runtime. That suits very low-end Android buyers with little storage, while the full Expo app serves power users and sellers.
gems.use_in_pool: 'POOL Lite' on the Play Store: the PWA wrapped as a tiny APK for Telugu and Hindi buyers on entry-level phones.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds a lightweight Play Store channel next to the Expo native app.
gems.license_or_pricing: Apache-2.0, free.
gems.activity_evidence: npm @bubblewrap/cli 1.25.0 modified 2026-09-28.
gems.maturity_risk: Low. It depends on Chrome being the TWA provider on the device.

gems.name: WhatsApp Payments India: order_details message (deep integration with Razorpay, PayU, Billdesk or Zaakpay; UPI Intent mode for any PG)
gems.what_it_is: Official Cloud API feature. The business sends an order_details (invoice) message and the buyer pays in chat through any UPI app, card, NetBanking or wallet. Deep-integration mode includes native payment-status webhooks.
gems.why_gem: For a WhatsApp-first India buyer, 'accept the seller's bid' can finish inside the chat, with no app install and no web redirect. Razorpay is supported in deep integration, and that PG can also be POOL's split-settlement aggregator. WhatsApp Pay itself processed 167.89M UPI transactions in July 2026 (Business Today).
gems.use_in_pool: When a pool closes, send each buyer an order_details message with their guaranteed per-buyer price. The payment goes into the aggregator's held and split flow, and the webhook updates pool state.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds in-chat checkout. It replaces the 'tap a link and open the payment page' step.
gems.license_or_pricing: Meta conversation pricing plus PG fees. Deep integration is limited to Razorpay, PayU, Billdesk and Zaakpay.
gems.activity_evidence: Live official Meta developer docs, checked 2026-09-30.
gems.maturity_risk: Medium. It needs WABA approval and PG authorisation, and UPI Intent mode has no native status notifications. Confirm with Razorpay that the order_details payment can use Route/split settlement.

gems.name: Kapso + Flowso (WhatsApp API platform and local WhatsApp Flows emulator)
gems.what_it_is: Kapso is a developer-first WhatsApp Cloud API platform (Show HN Dec 2025, $1.4M seed) with logs, webhooks, Flows, CLI, MCP and SDKs. Flowso is its MIT-licensed local emulator for WhatsApp Flows: it renders, validates and tests the data endpoint, and needs no Meta account.
gems.why_gem: Building WhatsApp Flows normally means iterating in Meta's WhatsApp Manager. Flowso lets the 5 devs build and test Flow JSON and endpoints locally on their Windows machines, and it works with coding agents. The Kapso free tier gives an instant pre-verified US number, which is useful for the US pitch demo while the Indian WABA is being approved.
gems.use_in_pool: WhatsApp Flows for 'start a pool' (product, quantity, closing time), 'join pool', and seller 'submit private bid' forms inside WhatsApp, with Telugu, Hindi and English copy.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Replaces the Meta WhatsApp Manager edit-test loop. Kapso is an alternative to Gupshup, Interakt or AiSensy for the prototype.
gems.license_or_pricing: Flowso: MIT. Kapso: Free $0 (2,000 msgs/month, 1 number, free pre-verified US number), Pro $25/month, Platform $299/month. Meta fees are extra, paid at cost.
gems.activity_evidence: Flowso created 2026-09-10 and pushed 2026-09-22, 15 stars (very new). Kapso Show HN 2025-12-23, 48 points.
gems.maturity_risk: Medium-high. Flowso is weeks old, and Kapso is a small startup based outside India. For India production, compare it with an Indian BSP on INR billing and support.

gems.name: WhatsApp Business-Scoped User IDs (BSUID) and usernames (2026 platform change)
gems.what_it_is: From 31 Mar 2026, Cloud API webhooks carry a BSUID in the form {country}.{alphanumeric}. Usernames launched in June 2026, and a user who hides their number arrives with only a BSUID.
gems.why_gem: This is not a tool; it is a hidden trap. A WhatsApp-first system keyed on phone number will fail to match returning buyers who adopt usernames. Designing identity around BSUID now avoids a painful migration.
gems.use_in_pool: Buyer identity table stores both BSUID and phone number. Pool membership, payment and delivery-code messages are keyed on BSUID when the number is hidden.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds an identity field; it replaces the phone-number-only design.
gems.license_or_pricing: Platform behaviour, no cost.
gems.activity_evidence: Multiple 2026 BSP write-ups (Hubtype, YCloud, Whapi, CM.com) and a Chatwoot GitHub issue. Rollout expands through H2 2026.
gems.maturity_risk: Low risk to adopt; the risk lies in ignoring it. The exact India rollout date is not confirmed.

gems.name: UPI Reserve Pay (formerly SBMD: Single Block, Multiple Debit)
gems.what_it_is: NPCI UPI capability. The buyer blocks an amount once with a UPI PIN, and the merchant debits it fully or partly one or more times. Unused funds are released at expiry or on manual release. The limit is ₹10,000 and validity is up to 90 days.
gems.why_gem: It maps closely to POOL: block the buyer's maximum at join, debit only the final Wave Drop price at close, and release the rest. That avoids 'charge, then partially refund', and the money stays in the buyer's own account until the pool closes. Cashfree and Pine Labs expose it via API.
gems.use_in_pool: India pool join: block up to the pool's max price, debit the final price at close, release the remainder. Good for meat and grocery pools under ₹10k.
gems.replaces_or_adds: An alternative to charging upfront and then refunding the Wave Drop, for tickets under ₹10k.
gems.license_or_pricing: PG pricing; must be enabled by the Cashfree account manager.
gems.activity_evidence: Cashfree and Pine Labs docs live. Supported UPI apps: Paytm, Navi, BHIM (PhonePe and Google Pay listed as 'coming soon' by Pine Labs).
gems.maturity_risk: High. The ₹10k cap is low, most users are on PhonePe and GPay, which are not yet supported, and it needs PG enablement. The RBI and regulatory fit for a marketplace hold must be checked with the PA.

gems.name: textbee (turn an Android phone into an SMS gateway)
gems.what_it_is: Open-source SMS gateway: an Android app plus a REST API that sends and receives SMS through a physical phone's SIM.
gems.why_gem: It lets the prototype show a real SMS fallback (delivery code, 'pool closed') without waiting on DLT registration with an Indian bulk-SMS vendor, and it can receive replies.
gems.use_in_pool: Demo-only SMS fallback when WhatsApp is not delivered, sent to team and pilot numbers.
gems.replaces_or_adds: A temporary stand-in for MSG91 or Twilio during the prototype.
gems.license_or_pricing: MIT. Self-host is free; a hosted plan exists at textbee.dev.
gems.maturity_risk: High for production. TRAI requires DLT-registered headers and templates for commercial SMS in India; sending bulk transactional SMS from a personal SIM is not compliant. Prototype only.

gems.name: RCS Business Messaging in India (Jio, Airtel and Vi in 2026)
gems.what_it_is: Rich, branded messages in the default Android SMS app (logo, images, buttons, cards) that fall back to plain SMS. Airtel signed with Google on 1 Mar 2026 (NSE filing), and Jio has worked with Apple on RCS.
gems.why_gem: Until 2026 Airtel's absence made RCS pointless in India. With all three carriers on board, it is a credible second rich channel after WhatsApp for buyers who mute WhatsApp business chats, with an automatic SMS fallback.
gems.use_in_pool: Later channel: pool-closing reminders and 'Track order' button messages with SMS fallback.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Adds a rich channel between WhatsApp and plain SMS.
gems.license_or_pricing: Through RBM partners or aggregators; per-message pricing varies.
gems.activity_evidence: Airtel-Google press release on NSE archives dated 2026-03-01, covered by Medianama and Storyboard18.
gems.maturity_risk: Medium-high. Brand verification, DND and promotional rules, and patchy device support on older Android.

gems.name: Lynx (ByteDance) 4.0
gems.what_it_is: Cross-platform UI framework from TikTok's team (open-sourced March 2025): a dual-threaded JS architecture with ReactLynx, targeting Android, iOS, web, HarmonyOS and desktop. Version 4.0 shipped 2026-09-11.
gems.why_gem: Its first-frame time on low-end devices is its selling point, and it has shipped monthly since launch (3.4 to 4.0). It is the one real challenger to React Native for 'feels native on cheap Android'.
gems.use_in_pool: Nothing now. Revisit for v2 if RN startup time on sub-₹10k Android phones becomes the bottleneck.
gems.replaces_or_adds: Would replace React Native or Expo.
gems.license_or_pricing: Apache-2.0, free.
gems.activity_evidence: 15,141 stars. Release 4.0.3 on 2026-09-11 (tag list also shows 4.1.0 on 2026-09-07). Pushed 2026-09-30.
gems.maturity_risk: High for a 5-dev team on a pitch deadline: small non-Chinese ecosystem, few payments and camera libraries, and no Expo-equivalent build service.

unverified: Syncular (github.com/syncular/syncular): verified as Apache-2.0, 300 stars, v0.20.0 released 2026-09-12, Show HN Aug 2026. Not evaluated deeply; too young (created Feb 2026) to recommend over Zero or PowerSync, so watch it.
Hermes v1 as the default engine in Expo SDK 57/58: the changelogs mention Hermes v1 fixes but I could not confirm it is on by default.
Declarative Web Push support in Chrome or Android: confirmed only for Safari/WebKit (iOS 18.4+).

zepto-labs/delta-server (a self-hosted RN OTA with delta updates, from Indian quick-commerce company Zepto): MIT, 50 stars, last push 2026-07-07. Not tested; interesting as an Indian production reference but low activity.

One framework (onestack.dev, a Vite-based universal React web plus native framework with built-in Zero integration): MIT, 4,490 stars, v1.27.1 on 2026-09-14. Not evaluated against Expo Router for POOL.
TanStack DB (@tanstack/db 0.9.2, MIT): pre-1.0 client-side reactive store for sync engines. Not evaluated.
Valdi (Snap, MIT, beta-0.2.0 on 2026-09-22, 16k stars): verified, but it has no web target, so it is excluded for POOL's PWA needs.
Rozenite (callstackincubator/rozenite, MIT, 662 stars): RN DevTools plugin panels. Useful for debugging but not evaluated.

UPI intent helper libraries found on GitHub (shambu2k/upi-intent, lokal-app/react-native-upi-app-launcher, vivnegi21/react-native-upi-launcher): all have fewer than 10 stars. Not recommended; use the payment aggregator's SDK or intent flow instead.

On-device OCR for Telugu: I did not find or verify an on-device OCR engine with good Telugu script support. ML Kit Text Recognition v2 covers Devanagari (Hindi) and Latin but I did not confirm Telugu. Keep product identification server-side.
WebOTP API and SMS Retriever for OTP autofill on Android Chrome: well-known standards, not re-verified today.
Whether Razorpay's WhatsApp order_details deep integration can route payments into Razorpay Route split settlement: needs confirmation from Razorpay.
Product Hunt as a discovery channel produced no qualifying gems (only small template apps).
